# ffee.me Link Submission Console

> A local-first, bilingual web workspace for managing multi-project submission materials, filtering a 500+ platform directory by Dofollow / backlink / free-submission attributes, browsing promotion communities and search-engine submission tools, and tracking backlink progress. No account, no server, no upload — all state is stored in the browser.

## Quick facts

- Product: ffee.me 外链提交工作台 / ffee.me Link Submission Console
- Type: single-file web application (HTML + CSS + vanilla JavaScript)
- Languages: Simplified Chinese and English
- Data storage: browser `localStorage` only
- Platform directory: 500+ built-in submission platforms across 9 categories: AI directories, SaaS review sites, launch/startup platforms, developer tools, social/content sites, community promotion, business/PR channels, search engines, and other channels
- Community promotion: 17 Reddit communities plus Designer News, Growth Hackers, and Lobsters
- Search-engine submission: Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, Yandex Webmaster, Baidu Search Resource Platform, Naver Search Advisor, Seznam Webmaster, and IndexNow
- Deduplication: platform entries are deduplicated by URL and by normalized name; the app also deduplicates imported data and merges the updated catalog into existing local data without duplicates
- Default project: ffee.me — a minimalist, multilingual online toolbox with 1000+ free tools, local file processing, and custom tool links
- Website: https://ffee.me/

## What the app does

1. Manage multiple projects side by side.
   - Each project has a product name, website URL, one-line tagline, and detailed description.
   - Projects can be added, removed, collapsed, and copied with one click.
2. Prepare submission materials.
   - Per-field copy buttons and a "copy all" action.
   - Projects are independent, so several products can be submitted in the same session.
3. Work through a platform directory.
   - Search by platform name or URL.
   - Filter by category and submission status (pending, submitted, approved, rejected).
   - Filter by Dofollow, backlink requirement, and free-submission support.
   - Mark attributes directly in the table with the D / B / F dots (gray = unknown, green = yes, red = no).
4. Use promotion communities.
   - 17 specific Reddit communities for launch feedback, SaaS, startups, indie hacking, AI tools, SEO, marketing, and small business.
   - Additional tech/design/growth communities: Designer News, Growth Hackers, Lobsters.
   - The generic "Reddit" entry is replaced by these specific communities; legacy Reddit notes/status are transferred to r/SideProject during migration.
5. Submit to search engines.
   - Dedicated "Search Engines" category with direct webmaster console links for Google, Bing, Yandex, Baidu, Naver, Seznam, and IndexNow.
6. Track progress.
   - Follow-up dates, per-platform notes, and live backlink URLs.
   - Automatic overdue highlighting.
   - Weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly backlink goals with a progress bar and coaching message.
7. Own the data.
   - Export a complete JSON backup (platforms, projects, goals, language).
   - Import a backup or a legacy platform array; imports are deduplicated by URL and name.
   - Old localStorage data is migrated automatically; the new catalog is merged into large existing lists without overwriting progress.
   - Data never leaves the browser.

## Data model

- `platforms[]`: id, name, url, category, dofollow, backlink, free, status, followUp, notes, links[]
- `projects[]`: id, name, url, tagline, desc, collapsed
- `okr`: cycle (`week` / `month` / `quarter` / `year`), target
- `links[]`: url, title, date

## Privacy

- No login, account, analytics, or server upload.
- Files and data stay in the browser.
- The only external request is the optional ffee.me logo asset.
